_comment: Naming configuration for the companion and tools/normalize-names.py.
Copy to naming-overrides.json and edit — that copy is gitignored, because it
describes your stack. Put the same file where the container can read it
(default /data/naming-overrides.json) so newly provisioned apps are compliant.
domains  : apex -> portal section family, and an optional display-name prefix.
Usually you want the section OR the prefix, not both: inside an
'Acme' section, an app named 'Acme Database' reads as Acme / Acme
Database. Applies to hosts you have not configured individually.
sections : slug -> function. Combined with the family this yields the portal
section label, e.g. 'Acme · Media'. Authentik sorts section labels
alphabetically, so this gives domain-first, function-second order.
UNASSIGNED APPS SORT ABOVE EVERY NAMED SECTION — assign them all.
overrides: slug -> display name, used VERBATIM. Only needed where the correct
name is something no algorithm guesses. Everything else falls back
to Title Case of the slug, with known initialisms upper-cased.
Plain JSON. No Claude, no API key, no network.
